road: Closed after the storm. Fallen trees, washed-out bridges.
Ask at the quay when it opens again.

lines: Harbour Tender Mave: Salt spring, fresh off the lake. Let your team rest after the crossing.

dockhand: Dockhand Tib: Veydal folk! First boat across since the storm. Mind the wet planks.

lines: Net-Hauler Bram: The quay empties at dusk and the little square by the spring fills up.
Sail-Mender Sina: I mend sails all day and trade stories all evening. The stories pay better.
Harbour Elder Tobin: Fifty years I watched the ferry come in. Now I watch it from the spring, sitting down.
A bench with a view over the lake. Sit and listen for a while?

lake_hint: A dockhand mutters as he passes: "Someone dropped a tonic among the trees on the west side. Never found it."

lines: Whisper Moll: Psst. Wayfarer. Every line hides a gift. Every gift has a price.
